title: Finite coefficient branch of arbitrary-affine Serre heart vanishing
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite commutative discrete topological ring A of Type 0 killed by a power of ℓ, and a commutative condensed ring Λ isomorphic to P ↦ C(P,A). Let X be affine [def-pc-scheme], and assume every affine etale V → X [def-weil-etale-morphism] has locally torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Use the fixed small pro-etale site and universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. If an internal Λ_X-module M lies in the weak Serre coproduct closure [sk-def-localizing-closure] of the finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], then its ordinary uncompleted module-derived sections [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, def-sfb-condensed-module-sections] satisfy H^q(RΓ(X,M[0]))=0 for every integer q>d+2. This holds without Noetherianity, also on empty schemes and for the zero ring.

source.place: Refinement (2), first paragraph; the finite discrete subcase of the coefficient-transfer obligation. Stacks Project Tags 03SA(3), 099Y and 09B1 supply the classical comparison route.

proof.text: Lift the small finite ring to the scheme universe and transport the given module along the induced condensed-ring isomorphism. Exact scalar restriction is an equivalence and transports finite scalar-model constructibility, so it transports the entire weak Serre coproduct hull.

Apply the finite discrete Serre heart bound with the identity étale test X. It gives vanishing for q>d. The given integer q>d+2 is nonnegative and satisfies this inequality. Sections commute with scalar restriction, and the classical/unbounded derived comparison on a single heart object gives precisely the displayed conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Refinement (2), first paragraph, finite discrete subcase; Stacks Tags 03SA(3), 099Y and 09B1, and exact étale/pro-étale comparison. F5 replaces the ind-finite-heart route by direct étale-origin comparison.

theorem finiteCoefficient_serreHeart_cohomology_vanishes
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (A : Type) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [IsTopologicalRing A] [Finite A]
    (htors : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0)
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (e : Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X] (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.weakSerreCoproductClosure.{u + 1}
      (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) M)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) + 2 < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
